title: 第3511章 未来教主有难第3510章 比他哥哥姐姐优秀
content_zh:
对面的三圣至尊目光一沉，咬牙说道：“即便如此，又能如何？被真正的古仙一族盯上，你们的下场，唯有死路一条！别忘了，他们背后，可是拥有真正的仙帝！我劝你们，还是赶紧束手就擒，投靠在冥月破晓古仙一族麾下，或许还能保住一命！”
叶倾城当即冷哼一声，轻蔑说道：“像你们一样，做他们手下的一条狗吗？难道你不知道，但凡主人家养的狗，无论多么忠诚，最终难免落得个剥皮抽筋，然后煮熟了端上饭桌的结局吗？”
三圣至尊当即目光一寒，咬牙嘶吼道：“看来，你们是真的想死！”
只见他嘶吼一声，再也没有一丝保留，立马动用了全部的底牌手段，试图尽快拿下对方二人。
谁知。
叶倾城和九天仙子对视一眼，忽然各自祭出一件半步太初仙器……
她们的实力，当即提升了一大截！
“什么？区区一步仙君，你们手中，居然也有太初至宝？”
三圣至尊当即目眦尽裂，怒声咆哮。
想他堂堂一尊七步仙君，拼搏了一辈子，都不曾获得一件太初至宝。
而对面二人，区区两尊一步仙君，居然人手一件太初至宝？
“天地不公！”
“今天，本尊必杀尔等！”
三圣至尊怒吼一声，彻底爆发，拼命杀向对方二人。
然而。
当叶倾城和九天仙子祭出了太初至宝之后，战局已经开始倾斜，她们二人逐渐占据上风！
另一边。
白衣天女、绝、太凰三人联手，正在围攻另外一尊七步仙君，八面仙君！
当他们看到了苏无敌那一招所造成的结果之后……
白衣天女当即双眼一亮，满脸感慨的说道：“这三个孩子，已经成长到这一步了吗？早就超越我等了啊！”

绝哈哈一笑，傲然说道：“无敌那孩子的确不错！不过……我那曾外孙女也很优秀，未来注定成就仙帝之位！”
太凰轻哼一声，同样一脸傲然的说道：“毅儿这孩子也很不错，像我！”
看到那些高位仙君全部都被打爆了肉身，就连修炼核心都黯淡了，八面仙君的脸色，早就凝重到了极点。
只见他忽然发出全力一击，击退了对面三人……
然后转身就逃！
“想逃，哪有那么容易！”
太凰和绝下意识就要去追！
白衣天女却是立马阻止了他们，沉声说道：“不要追！我们去帮助其他人！”
说完。
他们三人便分别冲向其它战场当中。
战场之上，敌人还有很多。
葬天教这边，已经战死了不少的仙君、仙王，虽然大多都是通过仙君破境丹和仙王破境丹强行提升上来的……
但是这些人，都是对葬天教、对苏尘最为忠诚的那一批。
其中许多，本身就是来自玄天神界的故人。
对白衣天女等人来说，陨落了哪一个都让他们心中无比沉重。
content_en:
The eyes of the Three Saints Supreme on the opposite side sank, and he gritted his teeth and said: "Even so, what can you do? If you are targeted by the real Ancient Immortal Clan, your only fate will be death! Don't forget, there is a real Immortal Emperor behind them! I advise you to surrender quickly and take refuge under the Ming Yue Dawn Ancient Immortal Clan, and maybe you can save your life!"
Ye Qingcheng immediately snorted and said contemptuously: "Are you a dog under their control like you? Don't you know that no matter how loyal the dog is, it will inevitably end up being skinned and cramped, and then cooked and served to the table?"
The Three Saints Supreme's eyes immediately turned cold, and he gritted his teeth and roared: "It seems that you really want to die!"
He roared, no longer holding back, and immediately used all his trump cards to try to win over the two opponents as soon as possible.
Who knows.
Ye Qingcheng and Jiutian Fairy looked at each other, and suddenly each offered a half-step Taichu Immortal Artifact...
Their strength immediately increased a lot!
"What? You are just a step-changed Immortal Lord, but you actually have the Supreme Treasure of the Beginning in your hands?"
The Three Saints Supreme's eyes were immediately split open and he roared angrily.
I think he is a majestic Seven-step Immortal King, who has worked hard all his life and has never obtained a piece of the Supreme Treasure of the Beginning.
And the two people on the opposite side, just two Immortal Lords of the First Step, actually each have one of the most precious treasures from the beginning?
"The world is unfair!"
"Today, I will kill you all!"
The Three Saints roared angrily, exploded completely, and tried their best to kill the two opponents.
However.
After Ye Qingcheng and Jiutian Fairy sacrificed the Taichu Treasure, the battle situation began to tilt, and the two of them gradually gained the upper hand!
other side.
The Heavenly Lady in White, Jue, and Taihuang join forces to besiege another Seven-step Immortal Lord, the Eight-faced Immortal Lord!
After they saw the results of Su Wudi's move...
The goddess in white's eyes immediately lit up, and she said with emotion: "Have these three children grown to this point? They have surpassed me long ago!"
Jue laughed and said proudly: "Wudi's child is indeed good! But... my great-granddaughter is also very good, and she is destined to become the Immortal Emperor in the future!"
Taihuang snorted lightly and said with the same proud look: "Yi'er is also a very good kid, just like me!"
Seeing that all the high-ranking Immortal Lords had their bodies blown apart, and even their cultivation cores were dimmed, the Eight-faced Immortal Lord's expression had already become extremely serious.
I saw him suddenly send out a full blow, knocking back the three people on the opposite side...
Then turn around and run away!
"It's not that easy to escape!"
Taihuang and Jue subconsciously wanted to chase after him!
But the goddess in white immediately stopped them and said in a deep voice: "Don't chase! Let's go help others!"
Finished.
The three of them rushed to other battlefields respectively.
There are still many enemies on the battlefield.
On the Burying Heaven Sect's side, many Immortal Lords and Immortal Kings have been killed in battle, although most of them were forcibly promoted through the Immortal Lord's Realm-breaking Pill and the Immortal King's Realm-breaking Pill...
But these people are the most loyal to the Burying Heaven Sect and Su Chen.
Many of them are old friends from Xuantian Divine Realm.
For the Heavenly Girl in White and others, the loss of any one of them makes their hearts extremely heavy.
